metaDescription: Order custom Rtmarketing luggage accessories for your team or event. Durable tags and identifiers with your logo. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Rtmarketing luggage accessories offer a smart way to keep your team's bags identifiable and professional. From durable leather luggage tags to versatile slip-in ID holders, these accessories withstand travel wear while displaying your logo. Ideal for corporate gifts, trade show giveaways, or employee recognition, they combine practicality with brand visibility. Choose from cowhide, bioplastic, or duo-textured finishes to match your brand's look.
